en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad city street lined with multi‑story European‑style buildings and shop awnings. Pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing cross the street and walk along the sidewalks. At the top center the caption reads "10. - ALEXANDRIA. - Rosette street". On the left corner building a sign reads "LLOYD" above another sign, and at the bottom right there is a printed website watermark "www.elia.org.gr".
